title: SMSD: A Semantic Misinformation Spreader Detection Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.27661v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Misinformation spreaders on social media significantly amplify false narratives, making early detection critical to mitigate their spread. Existing approaches often overlook evolving user behavior, introduce semantic noise by ignoring user stance, and fail to handle newly emerging users effectively. To address these limitations, we propose a \underline{S}emantic \underline{M}isinformation \underline{S}preader \underline{D}etection approach (SMSD) that models misinformation propagation as a temporal, user-centric, and behavior-driven learning problem. SMSD adopts a multimodal architecture that incorporates three categories of features: user-level, network-level, and conversation propagation. A stance-aware labeling strategy is also introduced to differentiate supportive, opposing, questioning, and neutral users towards misinformation claims. translated_title: SMSD：一种语义虚假信息传播者检测方法
translated_abstract: 虚假信息传播者在社交媒体上会显著放大虚假叙事，因此早期检测对于遏制其扩散至关重要。现有方法往往忽视用户行为的动态演变，因忽略用户立场而引入语义噪声，并且无法有效应对新出现的用户。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种语义虚假信息传播者检测方法，将虚假信息传播建模为一个时间性的、以用户为中心的、行为驱动的学习问题。SMSD采用多模态架构，融合三类特征：用户级特征、网络级特征和对话传播特征。同时引入了一种立场感知的标注策略，以区分对虚假信息主张持支持、反对、质疑和中立态度的用户。此外，还引入了月度分位数分析来模拟真实且不断演变的用户参与情况。
tldr: 提出SMSD方法，将虚假信息传播建模为时间性、以用户为中心、行为驱动的学习问题，通过融合用户级、网络级和对话传播特征的多模态架构与立场感知标注策略，实现对社交媒体虚假信息传播者的有效早期检测。
en_tdlr: SMSD is a multimodal, stance-aware approach that models misinformation spreading as a temporal, user-centric, behavior-driven learning problem, enabling early and effective detection of misinformation spreaders on social media.
